United Hope for Animals works to reduce companion animal homelessness through our Shelter Support Program at the LA County Baldwin Park Animal Care Center. Twice monthly Glamour Shots and videos for homeless pets are back!

If you are interested adopting a pet featured on this channel, please contact the Adoption Coordinator listed in the video description or visit the Baldwin Park Animal Care Center at 4275 Elton Ave., Baldwin Park, CA 91706. This is an LA County Shelter, and the status of pets updates daily. 

United Hope for Animals is an all-volunteer 501(c)(3) charitable organization. To volunteer, donate, or learn more, please visit unitedhopeforanimals.org.
